entities.title: Deploying the game, by hand
entities.summary: npm run deploy in the game's folder tests, builds and uploads the game; nothing deploys on a merge to main.
steps: npm test (the Worker), npm run test:godot (maps and the message layer)
npm run build: Godot 4.7.2 web export, the engine split in parts, boot.js
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/double-cross/.
entities.deployedBy: By hand: the owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs `npm run deploy` in games/double-cross (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates, and a Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys on a merge to main; the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and deploy it again by hand with `npm run deploy`. There is no database to undo.
